course_name_original: UE Conception et analyse de systèmes 1

learning_outcomes.text: From a given mechanism (real or defined by its digital model) and a technical problem to solve: Create a kinematic model to identify and locate structural and/or joint mobilities and hyperstaticities.
From a given mechanism (real or defined by its digital model) and a technical problem to solve: Propose and adapt a study model for the use of mechanical simulation software.

syllabus_topics: Study of mobilities and structural and joint hyperstaticities
Resolution (kinematic and/or multi-position static) using mechanical simulation software
degree: Licence Mécanique, parcours Génie mécanique et productique (2e et 3e année)
